messages:
maria: quick sync — we found a perf/regression signal on the marketplace images when upgrading to CUDA 12.2 + driver 540.x. need partner alignment on pinning and a hotpatch cadence. @alex can you summarize the CI findings?

alex: CI showed 10-15% p99 latency spike on batch workloads with cudnn/cuda changes. single-replica tests fine, multi-tenant queueing reproducible. suspect driver scheduling changes.

alex: repro script attached in CI logs, snippet:```bash
# check driver
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
# run perf harness
python tools/bench_batch.py --model gpt-4-mini --batch 8 --iters 200
```

maria: thanks. marketplace policy requires us to certify images. we should pin the driver and CUDA in the image manifest and notify cloud partners + SI integrators. proposed pins: `NVIDIA driver 535.86` + `CUDA 12.1` as temporary stable lane.

nvidia-eng: we can build a 535.86 hotpatch bundle with the scheduler tweaks. will provide packages and checksums by EOD PST. we'll also run our perf harnesses to validate.

jonathan: platform question — how do we represent this in the marketplace metadata? do we add a `driver_pin` field and `compat_fallback`?

alex: propose manifest snippet:```yaml
image: rwinference/rt-ubuntu22:2024-04-28
driver_pin: "535.86"
cuda: "12.1"
compat_fallback: ["cuda11.8-driver510"]
```

shiv: rollout plan: 1) build pinned images, 2) canary across 5% infra (marketplace test accounts), 3) monitor latency/cost, 4) open partner notice + hotfix repo. Target: canary tomorrow morning UTC, full rollout 72h if green.

maria: I'll draft the partner notice: include affected SKUs, pinned versions, temporary mitigation steps, and contact matrix for urgent escalations. cc @nvidia-eng for delivery timeline.

nvidia-eng: ack. we'll include a fallback driver package that supports automatic downgrade on regression. expecting bundle in ~6 hours.

deploy-bot: canary-ci/2305001200 -> FAILED :red_circle:
Logs: `batch_latency > threshold` on job canary-marketplace-2
Full log: https://ci.internal/runs/2305001200/logs

alex: saw the same. stacktrace points to nvml calls timing out in high-concurrency path. replicable locally with stress harness.

shiv: action items -> alex to prepare repro + minimal kernel cmdline; nvidia-eng to provide hotpatch bundle; jonathan to add manifest field and marketplace gating; maria to send partner notice + scheduling.

maria: also propose temporary ops SOP: if customer reports p99 regressions, instruct them to pin driver to 535.86 and restart runtime; note that this is a stopgap until we validate full 540.x path.

jonathan: I'll add `driver_pin` to the image schema and a gating check in the marketplace upload pipeline by EOD.

nvidia-eng: will run extended perf and confirm whether driver 540.x can be fixed or we recommend stays in non-production lane.

alex: once we have hotpatch we should run the KV/cache sensitive workloads — that's where latency hit is worst.

maria: timeline recap: EOD: vendor bundles + manifest change PR; TOMORROW 08:00 UTC: 5% canary; TOM+1 08:00 UTC: expand to 25% if green. I'll ping partners after we merge PRs.

shiv: added task cards and paging policy. if canary fails, we follow rollback to pinned image + notify customers.

maria: thanks all. I'll circulate the partner notice draft in this thread in ~2h. :mailbox_with_mail:
